# Locs Myth at Natural Essence

> Natural hair salon focused on locs in the Bixby Knolls neighborhood of Long Beach, California. Run by Danyette Thomas. Consultations, loc installations (traditional, micro locs, Sisterlock installation), loc extensions, interlocking and palm-roll maintenance, reconstruction and treatments, loc styles and color. By appointment; book on Booksy.

Website: https://locs-myth-natural-essence.netlify.app/
Also styled: Locs~Myth at Natural Essence; handle @locsmyth

## How booking works
- New clients start with a Consultation: $25, 30 minutes. In the salon's words: "This consultation will evaluate your hair and the desired look you want to achieve. Please bring pictures!"
- Installs: "For installation, a consultation and deposit required before appointment is confirmed."
- Install day: "Please come washed (no blow drying needed) and comfortable. You are welcome to bring snacks." Breaks are taken as needed.

## Services and prices (Booksy, October 12, 2026; "from" = starting price; final price confirmed at booking)
### Consultation
- Consultations: $25 (30min)
### Installations
- Loc Installation (Traditional): from $200 (1h 30min)
- Micro Loc Installation (Consultation Required): from $950 (6h 30min); $95 additional applies for length
- Sisterlock Installation (up to 4" in length): from $1,250 (15h); $95 per inch thereafter
- Loc Extensions: from $700 (6h); up to 5 hours, $100 per hour thereafter
### Maintenance and retwists
- Loc Maintenance Interlocked (High Density): from $140 (2h); includes shampooing
- Loc Maintenance Interlocked (Low Density): from $125 (1h 15min)
- Sisterlocks / Micro Locs Maintenance: from $150 (2h 15min); first 2 hours, then $40 per additional hour
- Loc Retwist Palmroll (High Density): from $125 (1h 30min); +$20 if past an 8-week maintenance schedule
- Loc Retwist Palmroll (Low Density): from $115 (1h); +$10 if past an 8-week maintenance schedule
- Quick Refresh / Tighten (Top Tighten): $55 (30min)
- Over due Add-on: $75 (1h 30min); 2 months past due maintenance
### Repair and treatments
- Loc Reconstruction: from $150 (2h)
- Loc Detox: $50 (30min); for odor, product build-up, lack of luster
- Deep Conditioning Therapy: $35 (20min); hot oil
- Keratin Protein Treatments: $65 (30min)
- Hair Steaming with Essential Oils: $65 (30min)
- Loc Shampoo: $30 (30min)
### Loc styles and cuts
- Loc Styles Simple: from $40 (30min); lobster, barrels, plaits
- Locs Styles (Time Intensive): from $50 (1h); two- or three-strand twists, curls, pipe curls
- Loc Style Cut / Trim/ Manicure: $40 (30min)
- Natural Hair styles: from $95 (1h 30min); loose natural styles including wet sets
### Color
- Color Simple (Roots / Basic touch up): from $85 (1h)
- Color Custom 1: from $135 (1h 30min); short hair, ombre, two tones, tips
- Custom color 2: from $180 (2h 30min); dense and long hair, highlights, lowlights, ombre, two tones
- Color Refresh / Rinse: $60 (30min)
- Color custom plus: $110 (30min)
### Off-site
- Off-Site Travel Half Day: $500 (3h 30min)

## FAQ
- Do I need a consultation before starting locs? Yes, for installs. A consultation and deposit are required before an installation appointment is confirmed. The consultation is $25.
- How much does it cost to start locs? Loc Installation (Traditional) from $200; Micro Loc Installation from $950; Sisterlock Installation from $1,250 for hair up to 4 inches plus $95 per inch after that.
- How often should I book maintenance? The menu is built around an 8-week maintenance schedule.
- Do you take walk-ins? Book ahead on Booksy so your time is held; call for same-day questions.
- Where is the salon? 4142 N Business St, Long Beach, CA 90807, in Bixby Knolls.
